project_type: Flask web app with static frontend (SPA-like navigation)
build_system: Flask dev server, no formal build step for frontend
test_framework: No formal test suite found - manual verification
verification_instructions: 1. Verify Python can import app.py without errors. 2. Verify HTML/JS/CSS have no syntax errors by inspection.
setup_instructions: pip install flask yt-dlp requests google-generativeai
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No formal test suite exists. API keys read from env vars (GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY) - never hardcode.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT touch TikTok downloader logic. Do NOT hardcode API keys. Do NOT break existing features.
key_patterns: SPA navigation via viewConfig in ui.js. Side drawer items use data-view and optionally data-feature attributes. Coming-soon items use featureMap + soon-badge class. Password gate rendered by _renderPasswordGate() in makima-ai.js. System prompt is _MAKIMA_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION in app.py. CSS uses dark glass theme with red accent (--red), var(--font-ui), var(--font-logo), etc.
directory_structure: app.py (Flask backend), templates/index.html (single page HTML), static/js/ (JS modules: ui.js, makima-ai.js, downloader.js, etc.), static/css/ (CSS modules: makima-ai.css, variables.css, etc.), static/img/ (images)
